# Dmitry Solovyev

## Statistician | Data Scientist | Policy Analyst 

### About me

Hello there! My name is Dmitry, I’m a statistician, data scientist, and policy analyst with over five years of experience tackling complex challenges in socio-economic, healthcare, and international policy domains. By blending quantitative methods (machine learning, forecasting, geospatial analysis) with qualitative research, I help organizations transform raw information into actionable insights. My background includes designing robust models—such as a COVID-19 data classification system leveraging time-series cross-validation—along with developing open-access policy databases that empower researchers worldwide.

Beyond technical expertise, I’ve driven public service improvements by analyzing personnel policies and advising on best practices at the federal level, including reforms shared with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Whether deploying data pipelines at TriMet or presenting findings at conferences, I focus on clear communication and inclusive collaboration, guiding projects from concept to completion. Fluent in English, Russian, and Ukrainian, I thrive in cross-cultural settings and aim to enhance policy decision-making on a broader scale.

### My education

- Master of Science in Statistics, Oregon State University, 2022-2024

- Master of Public Policy, Oregon State University, 2021-2023

- Master of International Relations, Moscow State Institute of International Relations, 2016-2018

- Bachelor of Political Science, Lomonosov Moscow State University, 2012-2016

### My skills

Statistics and data analysis: R (tidyverse, ggplot2, dplyr), Python (sklearn, pandas, numpy, plotly, seaborn, scipy, igraph), SQL

Cloud: BigQuery, pyspark

Visualization: Tableau, MPP 

Other software: ArcGIS, NetLogo, Atlas.ti, SPSS, STATA, Qualtrics
